QuestInfo.name: Rolonay's Request 2
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092012##k insists he's NOT afraid of monsters. Than why won't he go out?!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092012##k says he's too busy to go outside! It's his job to keep the Shiny Marble safe. He uses Pearls to keep it charged, but he's running low on them, so he wants you to get some more from the Pearl Oysters in the #rGenerator Room#k.
QuestInfo.2: You got him some Pearls. Maybe #b#p1092012##k is not as busy as he used to be...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 358 Can proceed to the Rolonay's Request 3 quest

0.0: And why should I be afraid of those little beasts? No, I've simply been too busy to go out. That's all.
0.1: Do you see this Shiny Marble? It's my duty to make sure nothing happens to it. Should I take my eyes off of it for even a second, it would mean disaster!\r\n
0.2: As a matter of fact, I'm running low on the Pearls that power this Shiny Marble. Might I trouble you to gather some for me?

yes.0: I am indebted to you. #b5#k #rPearls#k should do the job. All you need do is jaunt on down to the #rGenerator Room#k and take Pearls from the Pearl Oysters.

no.0: I assure you, this is of utmost importance! Shiny Marbles are no laughing matter!

1.0: Have you the Pearls? You've made great haste. Thank you, young Pirate.

yes.0: Tis a thankless task, but someone must tend to the Shiny Marble. If only Black Bark could see how hard I'm working.

item.0: Make haste, before the Shiny Marble loses its light! We need 5 Pearls to recharge it.
